```{r}
#| include: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
```

# Introduction

For this project, I have chosen to look at the NBA play-by-play data for the 2020-2021 seaason. Basketball was the first sport I really got into when I was growing up, and the analytics behind the sport is one of the reasons I wanted to pursue a Statistics degree when I started college. 

# Investigating the Data

```{r}
nba_data <- read_csv("NBA_PBP_2020-21.csv")
nba_data
```

Going through the data, we can see that there are a lot of missing values which makes sense, as some of the variables, such as ShotType, Blocker, Assister, etc... may not happen during that specific play. There might not be a shot attempted during that possession, for example. Therefore before looking at any numerical or graphical summaries, I'm going to remove those NA values for the variables I am interested in looking at.

```{r}
eda_data <- nba_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(ShotType), !is.na(ShotOutcome)) %>%
  mutate(
    ScoreDiff = HomeScore - AwayScore,
    TotalScore = HomeScore + AwayScore,
    IsAssisted = ifelse(!is.na(Assister), "Yes", "No"),
    QuarterLabel = case_when(
      Quarter == 1 ~ "Q1",
      Quarter == 2 ~ "Q2",
      Quarter == 3 ~ "Q3",
      Quarter == 4 ~ "Q4",
      Quarter == 5 ~ "OT1",
      Quarter == 6 ~ "OT2",
      TRUE ~ paste0("Q", Quarter)
    ),
    QuarterLabel = factor(QuarterLabel, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", 
                                                    "Q4", "OT1", 
                                                    "OT2"))
  )
eda_data
```

## Contingency Tables

First I'll look at some one-way contingency tables
```{r}
table(eda_data$ShotOutcome)
table(eda_data$ShotType)
table(eda_data$IsAssisted)
table(eda_data$QuarterLabel)
```

Now for the two-way contingency tables
```{r}
table(eda_data$ShotType, eda_data$ShotOutcome)
table(eda_data$ShotType, eda_data$QuarterLabel)
table(eda_data$ShotType, eda_data$IsAssisted)
```

## Numerical Summaries
```{r}
eda_data %>%
  group_by(ShotType, IsAssisted) %>%
  summarize(
    MeanDist = mean(ShotDist, na.rm = T),
    SDDist = sd(ShotDist, na.rm = T),
    MedianDist = median(ShotDist, na.rm = T),
    MeanDiff = mean(ScoreDiff, na.rm = T),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
eda_data %>% 
  group_by(QuarterLabel, ShotOutcome) %>%
  summarize(
    MeanHome = mean(HomeScore, na.rm = T),
    SDHome = sd(HomeScore, na.rm = T),
    MeanAway = mean(AwayScore, na.rm = T),
    SDAway = sd(AwayScore, na.rm = T),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Graphical Summaries
```{r}
plot1 <- ggplot(eda_data, aes(x = ShotType)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "navyblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Frequency of Shot Types in the 2020-2021 
       NBA Season",
       x = "Shot Type", y = "Count") + 
  coord_flip()
plot1
```

```{r}
plot2 <- ggplot(eda_data, aes(x = ShotType, fill = IsAssisted)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "blue", "No" = "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Assisted vs. Unassisted Shots by Shot Type for
       the 2020-2021 NBA Season", x = "Shot Type", y = "Count")
plot2
```
